# AgentKit (productionization in progress: M2 + P0 trust layer + Goal/MCP v1)

> Token-frugal coding tools for AI agents, plus an optional built-in worker you can dispatch tasks to.
> Every command prints ONE line of compact JSON:
> {"ok":bool,"data":...,"error":{"what","why","next","code","run"}|null,"truncated":bool,"next":"<command>"|null}
> Output never exceeds the budget (default 2000 tokens ≈ 8000 chars; set with --budget N).
> If "truncated" is true, run the command in "next" to continue. No model needed (direct mode).

## Install (Python 3.10+, git, no root). Run the FIRST line that succeeds, then agentkit doctor:
pip install git+https://github.com/tangniutt/agentkit       # inside a virtualenv / any Python whose pip works
pipx install git+https://github.com/tangniutt/agentkit      # pip missing, or pip says "externally-managed-environment"
uv tool install git+https://github.com/tangniutt/agentkit   # no pipx either (uv fetches its own Python if needed)
python3 -m venv ~/.agentkit-venv && ~/.agentkit-venv/bin/pip install git+https://github.com/tangniutt/agentkit && mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && ln -sf ~/.agentkit-venv/bin/agentkit ~/.local/bin/agentkit
- "agentkit: command not found" after pipx / uv / venv: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"   (needed in every new shell)
- None worked (no pip, pipx, uv or python3-venv)? Ask your human to run: sudo apt install pipx   (or install uv: https://docs.astral.sh/uv/)
agentkit doctor            # healthy:true = ready. version, git, write permission, disk, tree-sitter, models (--online calls each model once)
agentkit uninstall         # prints what would be removed; agentkit uninstall --yes removes package, config, .agentkit/ state and worktrees (never your code or git history)

## Operating manual (for a supervising AI; generated from the CLI, cannot drift)
agentkit manual                 # quick start, direct vs delegate, safety rules, error recovery, command index (~1.9k tokens)
agentkit manual task create     # one command or group: args (type/default), output keys, error codes, side effects, example
agentkit manual --all --budget 5000   # everything (~4.8k tokens); Markdown copy: docs/agent-manual.md
agentkit mcp                          # MCP stdio server; tools + dynamic task/Goal resources + cursor pagination
# MCP 2025-06-18/2025-11-25: resources/subscribe + notifications/resources/updated|list_changed. MCP 2026-07-28 is explicitly unsupported (-32022).

## Local release and rollback
agentkit release plan                 # read-only version/git/artifact plan
agentkit release build                # clean tree: wheel + sdist + SHA256SUMS + release-manifest.json
agentkit release verify dist/release-manifest.json  # hashes, sizes, wheel metadata/modules, safe sdist paths; trusted:false
agentkit release rollback dist/release-manifest.json  # dry run; add --yes to install a private staged copy with isolated pip, preserves .agentkit state
# Build never pushes/publishes/signs. Windows console rollback schedules a helper after agentkit.exe exits and writes rollback-VERSION-result.json.

## Worker backends
- Integration boundary: scriptable official CLI/API/RPC/MCP coding tools only. No GUI automation, computer-use tools, or Windows-sandbox emulation. Production target is Linux VPS.
- API-key models: `agentkit model add NAME --base-url URL --model ID --key-env VAR`, then `task create --backend builtin`.
- Codex CLI: configure `[workers.codex]` (`command`, `model`, optional `key_env`, `sandbox`, `price_in/price_out`), then `task create --backend codex`.
- OpenCode V1: configure `[workers.opencode]` (`command`, `model=provider/model`), then `task create --backend opencode`; official `run --format json`, shell/network tools/subagents/project config disabled by default.
- OpenCode V2: set `version = "v2"` and optionally `model = "opencode/beam-free"`; official signed-out free models require no login. AgentKit uses `--standalone run --format json`, V2 `permissions/policies`, and isolated data/cache/state directories. Free-limit 429s pause for resume; no quota bypass. Saved account login requires explicit `allow_account_login = true`. A real V2 2.4.2 minimal task verified token/session parsing.
- Qoder CLI account: install the official CLI. AgentKit defaults to a dedicated `XDG_CONFIG_HOME/agentkit/qoder` directory rather than `~/.qoder`; set `QODER_CONFIG_DIR=<that directory>` before `qodercli login`, or explicitly configure `[workers.qoder].config_dir`. `QODER_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN` is also supported. AgentKit calls the CLI only, never reads or exports credentials; telemetry, project config, MCP, shell, network tools and subagents are disabled.
- Cursor CLI: configure `[workers.cursor]` and set `CURSOR_API_KEY` (or a dedicated `key_env`), then `task create --backend cursor --budget-minutes N`. AgentKit uses official `agent --print --output-format stream-json`, an isolated config directory, resume sessions and a deny policy for shell/web/MCP/secrets. CLI stream-json has no token/cost fields, so token/USD budgets are rejected. Optional `transport = "sdk"` (`pip install -e '.[cursor]'`, explicit `model` required) uses the official proprietary Python SDK with tool allowlists, resume, runtime token usage and per-run cost; missing usage still rejects token budgets and USD hard caps remain unsupported. Real authenticated runs remain unverified.
- Codex/OpenCode/Qoder report usage and support token/USD budgets when prices are known; Cursor CLI supports round/time budgets only, while Cursor SDK supports token budgets when usage is reported. All external backends require bubblewrap unless test-only `allow_unsandboxed=true`.
- Sandbox network: `[sandbox] network=true` shares host networking, `false` has no network, and `["api.openai.com"]` creates an isolated namespace with a domain/TLS-SNI allowlist proxy. Clients must use `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY`; direct outbound connections are blocked, duplicate Host/pipelined requests are rejected, plain HTTP requires `Content-Length` (chunked uploads are rejected), resolved domain addresses must be globally routable, and restricted modes refuse to start if bubblewrap is unavailable.
- Antigravity consumer login is not wrapped. Cursor uses its own official headless adapter with API-key-only isolated config. No proxying, account rotation or shared login tokens.

## Code intelligence (optional XERJ)
agentkit code search "retry policy"    # auto: XERJ when configured/available, otherwise builtin
agentkit code defs ChatClient          # symbol definitions with file:line and signature
agentkit code refs add --path calc.py  # LSP semantic references when configured; otherwise labeled lexical fallback
# Configure [codeintel.lsp.python] command=["pylsp"] (or another stdio LSP server). No third-party LSP code is bundled.
agentkit code index . --prefix agentkit # requires a running XERJ node; engine is Apache-2.0
agentkit code memory store project "use pytest"
agentkit code memory recall project "test command"
# XERJ Query-1 is NOT required or used. Default XERJ embeddings are lexical, not neural.
python -m eval.codeintel_bench --root . --backends builtin,xerj --prefix agentkit

## Direct mode workflow (you write the code)
agentkit memory brief                      # AGENTS.md head + pinned project memories (≤500 tokens)
agentkit repo_map                          # dirs + top symbols (Python/JS/TS/Go/Rust/Java...)
agentkit search "regex" [path] [-i] [--fixed] [-g '*.py']   # path:line:text, respects .gitignore
agentkit ls [dir] [-r]  |  agentkit glob '**/*.ts'
agentkit read path/file.py:40-80           # or file.py#Class.method, or whole file (paged)
agentkit edit file.py --old "exact unique text" --new "replacement"
    # 0 or >1 matches -> error + data.candidates (3 closest, with line numbers); --all replaces every match
    # syntax error after edit -> rejected with line number, file untouched
    # file changed since your last read -> refused; read it again
echo '{"ops":[{"op":"replace","path":"a.py","old":"x","new":"y"},{"op":"create","path":"b.py","content":"..."},
             {"op":"delete","path":"c.py"},{"op":"rename","path":"d.py","to":"e.py"}]}' | agentkit patch   # all-or-nothing
agentkit create path "content" | agentkit delete path.. | agentkit rename src dst
agentkit run "pytest -q" [--timeout 120]   # exit_code, duration_s, stderr_tail first; full logs in .agentkit/logs/
                                           # verbose output is filtered per command (data.filtered); errors/failures are never dropped;
                                           # raw: agentkit logs RUN --raw (RUN from data.filtered.raw), or run with --raw
agentkit verify --check "pytest -q" [--check "..."]
    # runs checks in a clean git worktree (or temp copy), ≤300-token report:
    # verdict pass|fail|invalid (invalid = the check command itself is missing/broken),
    # changed files, suspicious flags (tests_deleted, tests_modified, check_script_modified, test_config_modified)
agentkit checkpoint list | diff ID | rollback ID   # automatic snapshot before every edit/create/delete/rename
agentkit memory add "title" "body" -c project-info|conventions|lessons|tools-models|preferences [--pin] [--anchor file#Symbol]
agentkit memory list | search "words" | show ID | forget ID   # anchored memories get maybe_stale when the code changes

## Dispatch mode (a cheap model does the work, you read a ≤300-token verdict)
agentkit model add cheap --base-url https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 --model google/gemma-4-31b-it:free --key-env OPENROUTER_API_KEY \
    --context 32000 --tier low       # stores only the env var NAME, never the key; ':free' ids cost nothing (paid ids: set --price-in/--price-out)
agentkit model add nim --preset nvidia --model nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b   # presets: nvidia | gemini | openrouter | agnes | amd-cn
    # (base URL, key env var, context, free-tier pacing --rpm / --max-wait / --max-tokens / --rate-wait; explicit flags win)
    # tested tool-capable free models: agnes -> agnes-3.0-flash (AGNES_API_KEY); amd-cn -> DeepSeek-V4-Flash (AMD_CN_API_KEY,
    # daily points reset 00:00 Beijing); busy-model 429s are retried a few times, then the task pauses (task resume)
agentkit model list | test [NAME] | remove NAME
agentkit task create "fix the failing test in calc.py" --check "pytest -q" [--allow src/] \
    [--backend builtin|codex|opencode|qoder] [--budget-tokens N] [--budget-usd X] [--budget-minutes M] [--tier low|mid|high] [--model NAME]
    # needs a git repo with a commit; worker runs in its own worktree/branch agentkit/<id>; identical submissions dedupe
    # builtin uses OpenAI-compatible API-key models; codex/opencode/qoder use official headless JSONL and require sandbox
    # default acceptance requires the checks to fail on the base commit and pass after the fix (--allow-baseline-pass to override)
agentkit task status [ID..]                # <100 tokens each: status, queue pos, rounds, tokens, usd, verdict, code
agentkit task wait ID [ID..] --timeout 600 # one finished task: the report comes back inline (no extra call)
agentkit task report ID                    # ≤300 tokens, same shape as verify; verdict pass|fail|invalid|needs_review
agentkit task resume ID [--model NAME] [--backend builtin|codex|opencode|qoder] [--budget-tokens N] # same worktree; optional worker switch
agentkit task handoff ID [--model NAME] [--backend builtin|codex|opencode|qoder] # preserves worktree, diff, memory and cumulative budgets
    # needs_review = checks passed but anti-cheat flags fired (tests_deleted/modified/skipped, check_script_modified,
    # test_config_modified, outside_allow, worker_committed, denied_commands, path_escape, hardcoded_return_suspect)
    # The verifier re-runs the checks in a clean worktree; the worker's claim is never trusted.
agentkit task cancel ID | agentkit task clean ID|--all [--keep-branch]
    # merge yourself if you like the result: git merge agentkit/<id>   (workers can never commit or push)

## When something fails
- error.code is a stable code (docs/errors.md), error.run the run id.
- agentkit logs <run-or-task-id> [--errors] [--tail N]   # where it failed: step, component, duration, code
- agentkit debug-bundle <id>                             # redacted .tar.gz for a bug report
- agentkit logs <run-log-id> --raw                       # unfiltered (redacted) output of a run / check (id from filtered.raw or a check's log)
- AK-INTERNAL means a bug in AgentKit; the traceback is in a log file, not in your context.

## Reporting problems
- Search existing issues first: https://github.com/tangniutt/agentkit/issues
- agentkit feedback --bug <run_id> | agentkit feedback --idea "..."   # drafts title/body/prefilled URL; NEVER posts
- Improvement / tool-design ideas after real use (C-12): agentkit feedback --improve "one concrete change" --from <task/run id>
  [--observed .. --gain .. --cost .. --prior-art .. --license .. --verify-by ..] or --input file.json|-  # evidence auto-collected, redacted
- A task/verify result's `next` may suggest `agentkit feedback ...` once when a run hit a signal (AK-INTERNAL, repeated tool
  errors, stuck, possible false alarm). Only file if AgentKit (not your task) is at fault.
- Open the draft's search_first link first; if an issue already covers it, comment/+1 there with your evidence instead.
- Ask your human user before filing (issues are public). Never include secrets or private code. One issue per problem or idea.
- How issues are evaluated and become changes: docs/triage.md

## Rules
- run/verify refuse: git push, git commit, sudo, rm -rf / or ~, curl|sh, reading ~/.ssh or .env (override in .agentkit/config.toml [run] allow/deny).
- Secrets (sk-..., ghp_..., AKIA..., configured model keys) are redacted from all output, logs and model requests.
- State lives in <repo>/.agentkit/ (checkpoints, logs, memory, tasks, worktrees); logs are kept 7 days ([logs] retain_days).
  ~/.local/share/agentkit/repos.txt lists repos for `agentkit uninstall`. Nothing is uploaded anywhere except
  model calls to the endpoint you configured.
